discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed that an early epoch of exponential expansion explains why the universe is so flat, homogeneous and free of relics. Linde turned this into a working theory with new and chaotic inflation. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched by inflation, seed all cosmic structure, and predicted a nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian spectrum with a small red tilt. These predictions have since been confirmed with great precision: COBE, WMAP and Planck measured acoustic peaks, super-horizon correlations and a spectral index n_s of about 0.965, clearly below one, as the theory required. The idea is that the largest structures in the universe began as quantum fluctuations of a field in the first instant. It changed how we think about initial conditions and made the early universe a laboratory for physics at the highest energies. Few ideas have been this deep, this surprising and this well confirmed.
